title: Adding vendor-specific log-transformed SMART features and linear trend slopes improves failure prediction performance
condition: The model uses additional engineered features: (1) vendor-specific log-transformed raw values of SMART attributes 187, 188, 190, 197, and 198; and (2) linear regression slopes of time-series SMART features in DELTA_FEATURES.
outcome: Weighted AUPRC and recall at 0.2% false alarm rate (FAR) increase on validation sets
scope: All hard drives in the dataset, grouped by serial_number, with at least two historical observations before cutoff
falsifier: If models trained with these new features show no statistically significant improvement (p > 0.05 via paired t-test across CV folds) in weighted AUPRC or recall@0.2% FAR compared to a baseline without them, the claim is falsified.
error: feature() 返回了 DataFrame（多列），但 discovery 只接受以 unit id 为索引的 pandas.Series；若只想要单列，用 .iloc[:, 0] 或 .squeeze() 取单列后再返回。
